facts.fact: La Nation reports that the three operators signed on Wednesday 4 February 2026 in Djibouti the agreement to launch Horizon, a planned terrestrial corridor of about 2,800 km with 144 fibre pairs joining Djibouti, Addis Ababa and Port Sudan, following a memorandum signed in Addis Ababa on 4 December 2024.

systems.owner: Djibouti Telecom, Ethio telecom and Sudatel Group
systems.tiers: operators; hyperscalers and carriers as prospective customers
